pulse.zh: 再检查一下汤姆的脉搏。

phone.en: Tom wanted Mary's phone number, but she refused to give it to him.
phone.zh: 汤姆想要玛丽的电话号码但是被拒绝了。

planet.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
planet.zh: 水星是我们的太阳系中最小的行星。

proposal.en: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
proposal.zh: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

pants.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.

patient.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
patient.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

pray.en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
pray.zh: 现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。

pure.en: The sample is not pure enough.

pretty.en: I have a pretty good idea who Tom will be hanging out with tonight.
pretty.zh: 我大概知道汤姆今晚会和谁一起玩。

pretend.en: There's no need to pretend anymore.

pain.en: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
pain.zh: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

pale.en: He told me that I looked pale and asked me what the matter was.
pale.zh: 他跟我说我很苍白，并问我怎么了。

progress.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
progress.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

part.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
part.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

paint.en: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.
paint.zh: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。

practical.en: He was an intelligent and practical man.

power.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
power.zh: 纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

peace.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
peace.zh: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

project.en: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
project.zh: 该公司在这个企划中投入了很多钱。

promise.en: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.
promise.zh: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。

pattern.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
pattern.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

proud.en: He is proud of having been educated in the United States.
proud.zh: 他对自己在美国读过书这件事感到很骄傲。

prison.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
prison.zh: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

pink.en: Who is the woman dressed in pink?
pink.zh: 那个穿粉红色衣服的女人是谁？

purse.en: It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
purse.zh: 那是在我到家以后，我才不见了我的钱包。

poem.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
poem.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

property.en: He passed his property on to his son.
property.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。

politician.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
politician.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。

pie.en: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
pie.zh: 我可以吃一块苹果派吗？

protection.en: He did not think he needed their protection.
protection.zh: 他认为他不需要他们的保护。

prisoner.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
prisoner.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

permit.en: Will you permit me to go there?

pig.en: A hungry pig dreams of acorns.

player.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
player.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

prove.en: I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.
prove.zh: 我只想向自己证明我可以做到。

police.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
police.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

prize.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
prize.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖后，她仍谦虚如昔。

perhaps.en: I do not remember seeing the letter, but perhaps I read it.
perhaps.zh: 我不记得我看过这封信, 但或许我读过它。

propose.en: I'm going to propose to her.

point.en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
point.zh: 现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。

patience.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
patience.zh: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。

pillow.en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
pillow.zh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

prefer.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
prefer.zh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。

participate.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.

pop.en: I'd like to listen to pop music.

protect.en: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
protect.zh: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

private.en: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
private.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。

probably.en: Tom probably knows where we can get something to eat around here.
probably.zh: 汤姆应该知道这附近哪里有东西吃。

picnic.en: I can still remember the time when we went on a picnic together.
picnic.zh: 我还记得我和你一起去野餐的时候。

peach.en: Tom isn't eating a peach. He's eating a plum.
peach.zh: 汤姆没有吃桃子，他在吃李子。

pleasant.en: She had a pleasant dream last night.

physics.en: He had a book on physics published.
physics.zh: 他有一本关于物理学的书被出版了。

plenty.en: The doctor insisted that the patient get plenty of rest.
plenty.zh: 医生坚持病人获得充分的休息。

paragraph.zh: 这一个段落是模糊不清的。

program.en: If you do not have this program, you can download it now.
program.zh: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。

pinch.en: Add a tiny pinch of salt.

proceed.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
proceed.zh: 让我们继续进行议程上的项目。

pint.en: Beer is sold by the pint.

pepper.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
pepper.zh: 我在鱼上洒盐和胡椒作调味。

principal.en: Our school's principal is very old.

president.en: Tom started as a janitor, but he's now the president of the company.
president.zh: 汤姆最初是看门人，但现在他是公司的总裁了。

package.en: Did you get the package that I sent you?
package.zh: 你收到我寄给你的包裹了吗？

painting.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
painting.zh: 这幅画被估价数百万元。

prince.en: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
prince.zh: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人

provided.en: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
provided.zh: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

pregnant.en: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
pregnant.zh: 455名妇女中会有一名直到怀孕第二十周前没有意识到自己怀孕。

pet.en: She keeps a parrot as a pet.
pet.zh: 她养一只鹦鹉作为宠物。

pitch.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.

pressure.en: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.

peel.en: I'll peel an orange for you.

pride.en: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
pride.zh: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。

percent.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
percent.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

pot.en: Put the carrots in the pot.

pound.en: Fish is sold by the pound here.
pound.zh: 鱼在这里是以磅为单位来出售。

painful.en: There's nothing more painful than losing one's child.
painful.zh: 没有比失去孩子更伤心的事。

puzzle.en: Have you worked the puzzle out?

provide.en: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
provide.zh: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。

pirate.en: Tom was dressed like a pirate.

promising.zh: 他是一位有前途的学生。

poison.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
poison.zh: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。

professor.en: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
professor.zh: 那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。

plus.en: The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.

pan.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
pan.zh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。

pond.en: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
pond.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。

prevail.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

privacy.en: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
privacy.zh: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

passion.en: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
passion.zh: 诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。

political.en: It takes time to develop political awareness.
political.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。

poet.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
poet.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

public.en: It is sometimes difficult to make yourself understood in public.
public.zh: 有时很难在公众场合表达你自己的意思。

punctual.en: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
punctual.zh: 与她的妹妹相比，她不是很准时。

path.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
path.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

positive.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
positive.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。

prepare.en: Every morning she helps her mother to prepare breakfast in the kitchen.
prepare.zh: 她每天早上都帮母亲在厨房准备早餐。

prophecy.en: She has a gift for prophecy.

persuade.en: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
persuade.zh: 说服他中止旅行真是件苦差事。

parachute.zh: 汤姆的降落伞没有打开。

period.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
period.zh: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

pilot.en: My dream is to become a pilot.
pilot.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

polish.en: I got him to polish my shoes.

prescription.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
prescription.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

privilege.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
privilege.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

puppy.en: This is the cutest puppy I've ever seen.
puppy.zh: 这是我见过最可爱的小狗。

plastic.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
plastic.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

personality.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
personality.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

photograph.en: My grandfather's photograph is on the wall.
photograph.zh: 我祖父的照片在墙上挂着。

particularly.en: The youngest daughter was particularly beautiful.

partial.en: It was only a partial success.

pocket.en: The kitchen knife wasn't sharp enough to cut the meat, so I used my pocket knife.
pocket.zh: 这把菜刀不够锋利，所以我用了我的折叠刀来切肉。

prey.en: The lion is stalking its prey.

physician.en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
physician.zh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。

politics.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
politics.zh: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。

pronounce.en: Is there anyone who can pronounce this word?

pool.en: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
pool.zh: 若你住到的是大的旅馆，就能使用他们的游泳池。

purpose.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
purpose.zh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。

policy.en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
policy.zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

popular.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
popular.zh: 在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

predict.en: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
predict.zh: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

process.en: The whole process will take months.
process.zh: 整个过程需要耗费数月。

palm.en: I am interested in palm reading.
palm.zh: 我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。

plain.en: Could you say that in plain English?

priest.en: My brother has become a priest.
priest.zh: 我的兄弟已经成为了牧师。

precious.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.
precious.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。

pack.en: She helped me pack my suitcase.
pack.zh: 她帮我打包我的手提箱。

product.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
product.zh: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。

professional.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
professional.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

permission.en: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.

personal.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
personal.zh: 汤姆上网时并不在乎个人资讯的保护。

penny.en: A penny saved is a penny earned.
penny.zh: 省下了一分钱，就等于赚了一分钱。

potential.en: Every man is a potential corpse.
potential.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。

poster.en: He paused to look at the poster.

phrase.en: What's the meaning of this phrase?

pebble.en: She stooped to pick up a pebble.

population.en: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
population.zh: 在2020年以前，我们的城市的人口将增加一倍。

pamphlet.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.

philosopher.en: I wanted to become a philosopher.

production.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
production.zh: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。

powder.en: The table is covered with powder.

poetry.en: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
poetry.zh: 他们视乔叟为英诗之父。

pacific.en: He crossed the Pacific Ocean in thirty days.

parallel.en: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.
parallel.zh: 平行四边形的对边平行。

properly.en: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.
properly.zh: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。

philosophy.en: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.
philosophy.zh: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。

passive.en: Watching TV is a passive activity.
passive.zh: 看电视是一种被动的活动。

pipe.en: Water poured from the broken pipe.
pipe.zh: 水从破裂的水管倾泻而出。

performance.en: What time is the next performance?

painter.en: You're a good painter, aren't you?
painter.zh: 你是个很棒的画家，不是吗？

press.en: If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
press.zh: 如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。

particular.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

pastime.en: Playing cards is a popular pastime.
pastime.zh: 打牌是一种流行的消遣方式。

purple.en: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
purple.zh: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜欢灰色的毛衣。

purchase.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
purchase.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

pour.en: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
pour.zh: 将融化了的奶油倒入爆米花中。

princess.en: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess.

parcel.en: The address on this parcel is wrong.
parcel.zh: 这个包裹上的地址是错的。

partly.en: The wall is partly covered with ivy.
partly.zh: 墙被常青藤覆盖了一部分。

penalty.en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
penalty.zh: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

phenomenon.en: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.

previous.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
previous.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

position.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
position.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

prairie.en: Laura Ingalls grew up on the prairie.
prairie.zh: 劳拉英戈尔斯是在草原上长大的。

possibility.en: There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
possibility.zh: 你有可能不得不那么做。

paradise.en: The island is a paradise for children.
paradise.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。

panel.en: A panel of experts discussed the plan.
panel.zh: 一个专家小组讨论这个计划。

pronunciation.en: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
pronunciation.zh: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

permanent.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

prevent.en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
prevent.zh: 你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？

preserve.en: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
preserve.zh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。

preparation.en: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
preparation.zh: 我们因缺乏准备而失败了。

puppet.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.
puppet.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。

probe.en: The probe is equipped with a microphone.

possession.en: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
possession.zh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。

parade.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
parade.zh: 一大群人聚在一起看巡游。

payment.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
payment.zh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。

plot.en: They accused him of being part of the plot.
plot.zh: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。

physically.en: Tom was there physically, but not mentally.

presence.en: I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
presence.zh: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。

pace.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
pace.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。

photography.en: I participated in a photography competition.
photography.zh: 我参加了一个摄影比赛。

pine.en: There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.
pine.zh: 以前我家前面有棵大松树。

pollution.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
pollution.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。

pillar.en: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
pillar.zh: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。

perform.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
perform.zh: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。

primary.en: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
primary.zh: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。

proverb.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

precise.en: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
precise.zh: 他们到达的确切时间还不明。

pose.en: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
pose.zh: 当你提出一个问题，你期望得到答案。

pretext.en: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
pretext.zh: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

prime.en: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
prime.zh: 总理的发言估计激怒了在野党。

panic.en: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
panic.zh: 地震后人们普遍觉得恐慌。

prejudice.en: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.
prejudice.zh: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。

possibly.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
possibly.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

producer.en: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
producer.zh: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

pin.en: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
pin.zh: 安静到连针掉在地上的声音你都会听得到。

practically.en: Tom would do practically anything to keep Mary happy.
practically.zh: 为了哄玛莉开心，汤姆几乎会做任何事。

printer.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
printer.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

pearl.en: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
pearl.zh: 日本人在一九四一年十二月七日袭击珍珠港。

playground.en: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.
playground.zh: 一群年轻人在操场上打手球。

phase.en: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
phase.zh: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。

preceding.en: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
preceding.zh: 第三季国民生产总值较上一季成长了1％。

passenger.en: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
passenger.zh: 汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。

punishment.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
punishment.zh: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

possess.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
possess.zh: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

publication.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
publication.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

pregnancy.en: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
pregnancy.zh: 455名妇女中会有一名直到怀孕第二十周前没有意识到自己怀孕。
